repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: μ-阿片受體促效劑理論上可透過脊髓後角痛覺調節抑制偏頭痛發作時的痛覺傳遞，並可能影響皮質擴散性抑制（cortical spreading depression, CSD）。然而：(1) 阿片類藥物非偏頭痛標準治療，長期使用有高度反彈性頭痛風險；(2) 現有文獻均屬間接或偶發性證據；(3) Alfentanil 短效特性（t½α ~1min）不利於偏頭痛的預防或急性治療。

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 基底動脈型偏頭痛/腦幹先兆偏頭痛涉及腦幹神經元過度興奮與血管功能異常。Alfentanil 的 μ-阿片受體活化可能通過腦幹中央導水管周圍灰質（PAG）的痛覺調制有部分理論連結，但阿片類藥物在此亞型中使用有特殊風險（呼吸抑制疊加腦幹症狀），且無臨床試驗支持。唯一文獻（PMID 2896809）為間接基礎科學文獻，不構成臨床證據。

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Dandy-Walker 畸形為先天性後顱窩/小腦蚓部發育異常，屬結構性神經發育缺陷，非可藥物治療的功能性病理。阿片受體促效劑對神經管閉合缺陷或後顱窩發育無影響機制。此預測可能源自 TxGNN 知識圖譜中神經系統疾病的廣泛關聯，缺乏生物學合理性。

literature.abstract: The aim of this retrospective case series was to report the performance up to 5 years of an innovative surgical design (the apically incised coronally advanced surgical technique [AICAST]) for the regenerative treatment of one- or two-walled intrabony periodontal lesions.

literature.abstract: Cluster headache is a severe hemifacial pain with concomitant symptoms such as lacrimation, conjunctival congestion, and nasal discharge. Peripheral (to be a spectrum of trigeminal autonomic cephalgia) and central (hypothalamus) disorders have been suggested to be involved. Several modalities have been recommended to prevent or alleviate this devastating headache.

literature.title: Anaesthesia for caesarean section in women with complex cardiac disease: 34 cases using the Braun Spinocath spinal catheter.
literature.abstract: Cardiac disease in pregnancy is now the leading medical cause of maternal mortality in the UK. Whilst anaesthesia has not been the precipitant of this morbidity, its safety cannot be taken for granted. Spinal catheter anaesthesia, a relatively uncommon choice in obstetric practice, offers the potential of maintaining haemodynamic stability through accurate and gradual titration of neuraxial blockade.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Alfentanil 作為強效短效 μ-阿片受體促效劑，透過以下機制可能對難治性頭痛（特別是叢集性頭痛急性發作）有緊急處置價值：(1) 中樞性痛覺抑制（脊髓後角 + 腦幹 PAG）；(2) 三叉神經-血管通路的快速抑制；(3) 短效特性（作用持續 5-10 分鐘）減少阿片類依賴風險。有1篇直接案例報告（PMID 24910816）支持 propofol + alfentanil 組合用於難治性叢集性頭痛。定位為「難治性頭痛之急救靜脈用藥」而非常規治療。
